design_strengths: Fixed N4 language replay isolates interpreter change without new inference.
Six small engineering comparisons have explicit distinct mechanisms and capped calls.
N12 compares uniform, smoothed and hard-pruned priors using one physically shared proposal pool with separate standalone cost accounting.
N13 produces provenance-bound synthetic data only; no training benefit is claimed.
N14 excludes the8 design tasks and uses exactly the32 previously exposed N3 tasks, leaving136confirmation untouched.
Admission and evidence gates run before environment installation/model loading.
N14 policy allowlist and complete source-report or blocked-receipt requirement prevent subjective winner picking.
changes_required_and_addressed: Correct N14 tuning[0:32] to tuning[8:40] and its exposure description.
Specify policy allowlist and complete gate ledger including exclusions.
N12 CPU deadline includes child startup/verification; late candidates excluded; full proposal cost charged to each standalone comparison.
N10 described as information/trajectory contrast, not equal-token single-step causality.
Separate N13 curriculum/data validation from actual objective-training efficacy.
final_review_requirements: Frozen exact interpreter and verifier security approval, including IR/compiler and synthesis routes.
CPU-only N5/N13 path works without GPU/model/CUDA or unnecessary weight scan.
Data-family identities and heldout family split are actually enforced before generation/augmentation.
All actual new planning/repair/search calls and CPU work counted; no retries or silent denominator replacement.
Every gated notebook checks actual source-bound evidence; missing input gives an inert BLOCKED result, not an unchecked override.
Native tokenizer audits on full visible prompts, plus runtime exact prompt IDs and overflow accounting.
Independent tests for truth isolation, deadlines, partial usage, process stop, seal, selection, notebook inertness, and exact hash closure.
Final Git integration remains add-only for unrelated existing code; old baseline failures are not misreported as new regressions or full green.
interpretation_limits: Eight design tasks and32 consolidation tasks are previously exposed public/tuning data.
The512 synthetic episodes do not create512 independent rule families; only8 authored families are proposed.
Budget ceilings do not equal realized costs, and watchdog values do not cap total billing.
Helper shadowing was already allowed; reimplementation caused unsupported syntax and cost rather than redefinition itself being the rejection.
Tuning evaluator scores can select the later experiment-level policy; the per-task candidate selector remains query-label-free.
